evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Rooms, views, and objects form a coarse-to-fine retrieval graph.
Fixed construction adds evidence during exploration. For ObsGraph, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of room-linked visual views.
During operation, ObsGraph applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to room-linked visual views; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, ObsGraph applies relinking or reindexing of stored items to room-linked visual views; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, ObsGraph applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to room-linked visual views; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (room-linked visual views) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, relinking or reindexing of stored items, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
